notice: Every numeric value below is a provisional placeholder picked by the developer for testing, not a clinical judgment. A licensed physiotherapist must review and set appropriate values per patient before this is used for real feedback.

min_elbow_straight_deg.comment: Was 150. Lowered to 135 based on the training-correct per-rep MIN elbow angle across all 100 UI-PRMD m07-correct reps (Kinect FK positions, via the same compute_elbow_angle()): min=138.0 deg -- 150 would have flagged 14/100 of UI-PRMD's own correct reps. 135 sits just under that observed floor. This is still Kinect-derived, not webcam-derived -- must be re-set from real webcam calibration clips (data/clips_manifest.csv, set=calibration) once enough exist.

cues.peak_angle: Raise your arm closer to the target height.
cues.elbow_straight: Keep your elbow straighter as you raise your arm.
cues.trunk_lean: Keep your torso upright -- try not to lean.
cues.tempo: Move at a steadier, more controlled pace.
cues.insufficient_data: Keep your whole arm in view.
